card.name: Sentence and number boundaries in labels
card.fires_on: Punctuation and spacing at boundaries in drug-label text: sentence-ending periods, closing parentheses after section numbers, and spaces before a number in dose or range text.

modes.label: Sentence-ending period or parenthesis
modes.description: A period or closing parenthesis that ends a clause or section reference, just before a new sentence or heading.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space or digit inside a dose, range, or section number such as 40 mg or 3 days.

modes.label: Start of a name or code
modes.description: The first letter or piece of a brand or enzyme name such as FASPRO or CYP2C8.
